gui.refugio.dialogue.title: Refuge Conversation
dialogue.refugio.baldur.1: I'm Baldur, the Refuge merchant. I help the community trade coins for supplies for the journey.
dialogue.refugio.starter_bag.1: As you arrive in this world, you find a small leather pouch lying nearby.
dialogue.refugio.starter_bag.2: Inside is a Refuge Key, able to open the way back to a safe shelter.
dialogue.refugio.starter_bag.3: Along with the key, there are 50 coins. You pocket everything to begin your journey.
dialogue.refugio.baldur.2: I also buy some useful resources. Check the offers and choose what you need for your next expedition.
dialogue.refugio.eldrin.1: I'm Eldrin, the chronicler of this community. I record the steps that bring us closer to the End.
dialogue.refugio.eldrin.2: When you complete an objective, return here to claim the mission and its reward.
dialogue.refugio.marta.1: The garden keeps the Refuge alive. I'm Marta; I can guide your work with crops and animal care.
dialogue.refugio.marta.2: Bring what the community needs and check available tasks to earn supplies.
dialogue.refugio.dario.1: I'm Dario, cartographer and alchemist. Every journey brings clues about the Rupture and the hordes.
dialogue.refugio.dario.2: Prepare carefully, complete expedition objectives, and return to claim your reward.
message.refugio.ability.locked: This skill is locked. Purchase the previous skill in its track.
message.refugio.ability.max_rank: This skill is already at maximum rank.
message.refugio.ability.choose_free_firs: Choose your free starting skill with Kael first.
message.refugio.ability.castle_only: Abilities can only be accessed while Kael is at the castle.
message.refugio.kael.departed: A swirl of particles surrounds Kael. He has vanished—find him at the castle.
dialogue.refugio.kael.arrival.1: Hey, traveler. You made it to the Refuge—breathe; we are safe in here.
dialogue.refugio.kael.arrival.2: This place was built by those who refused to abandon others. The hordes are still out there.
dialogue.refugio.kael.arrival.3: Explore the village, then find me at the castle. There is something about the Rupture we need to understand.
dialogue.refugio.kael.entrance.reminder: Explore the village first. When you are ready, meet me at the castle.
dialogue.refugio.kael.castle.1: I was a guard. I was the only one on my team to survive the first great horde.
dialogue.refugio.kael.castle.2: A blue fragment fell into a cave and gave me powers I am still trying to understand.
dialogue.refugio.kael.castle.3: Its energy feels like the Rupture. I can help you master abilities—choose your path carefully.
dialogue.refugio.kael.castle.reminder: The fragment and the Rupture share the same signature. There is still much to discover.
message.refugio.training_dummy.spawned: The training zombie is at the castle beside Kael. It has %1$s health, does not attack, and respawns 2 seconds after dying.

quest.refugio.description.1: Craft iron tools and prepare your equipment.
quest.refugio.description.2: Obtain obsidian and prepare to ignite the portal.
quest.refugio.description.3: Build a portal and enter the Nether.
quest.refugio.description.4: Find a fortress and obtain a Blaze Rod.
quest.refugio.description.5: Use an Eye of Ender to locate the stronghold.
quest.refugio.description.6: Activate the portal and enter the End dimension.
quest.refugio.description.7: Defeat the Ender Dragon. This is the final mission.

quest.refugio.garden.description.0: Turn in 16 wheat to the Keeper of the Garden.
quest.refugio.garden.description.1: Turn in 12 cooked foods: meat, fish, or baked potatoes.
quest.refugio.garden.description.2: Turn in 16 potatoes or carrots in any combination.
quest.refugio.garden.description.3: Breed animals and complete the corresponding vanilla advancement.
quest.refugio.garden.description.5: Obtain a piece of armor and complete the corresponding vanilla advancement.
quest.refugio.garden.description.7: Turn in 30 bread and 32 torches for the expedition.
quest.refugio.expedition.description.0: Sleep in a bed for the first time in this world.
quest.refugio.expedition.description.1: Turn in 5 coal and 5 raw iron.
quest.refugio.expedition.description.2: Turn in 12 lapis lazuli and 5 gold ingots.
quest.refugio.expedition.description.3: Complete at least one trade with a villager.
quest.refugio.expedition.description.4: Turn in any potion. Rewards include 10 long Fire Resistance potions and 2 Strength II potions.
quest.refugio.expedition.description.5: Travel at least 1,000 blocks by boat (cumulative distance).
quest.refugio.expedition.description.6: Find ancient debris, the raw ore of netherite, and complete its advancement.
quest.refugio.expedition.description.7: Enchant a bow and keep it in your inventory. Rewards include spectral arrows and a Power V book.
message.refugio.ability.no_movement_skil: No movement skill is active or ready right now. Visit Kael at the castle to manage your Reflexes.
skill.refugio.sword_critical_chance.name: Critical Chance
skill.refugio.sword_critical_chance.desc: +10 percentage points per rank, up to +50%; critical hit chance with swords against enemies.
skill.refugio.sword_critical_damage.name: Critical Damage
skill.refugio.sword_critical_damage.desc: +20% critical multiplier per rank, up to +100% at rank 5; affects jump crits and Critical Chance crits with swords.
skill.refugio.sword_first_cut.name: First Cut
skill.refugio.sword_first_cut.desc: After 5 s without dealing combat damage, your next sword strike against an enemy gains +15% per rank (max +75%).
skill.refugio.sword_mastery.name: Sword Mastery
skill.refugio.sword_mastery.desc: +10% sword damage per rank, up to +50% at rank 5.
skill.refugio.axe_critical_chance.name: Critical Chance
skill.refugio.axe_critical_chance.desc: +10 percentage points per rank, up to +50%; critical hit chance with axes against enemies.
skill.refugio.axe_critical_damage.name: Critical Damage
skill.refugio.axe_critical_damage.desc: +20% critical multiplier per rank, up to +100% at rank 5; affects jump crits and Critical Chance crits with axes.
skill.refugio.axe_first_cut.name: First Cut
skill.refugio.axe_first_cut.desc: After 5 s without dealing combat damage, your next axe strike against an enemy gains +15% per rank (max +75%).
skill.refugio.axe_mastery.name: Axe Mastery
skill.refugio.axe_mastery.desc: +10% axe damage per rank, up to +50% at rank 5.
skill.refugio.bow_critical_chance.name: Critical Chance
skill.refugio.bow_critical_chance.desc: +10 percentage points per rank, up to +50%; critical hit chance on bow arrows against enemies.
skill.refugio.bow_critical_damage.name: Critical Damage
skill.refugio.bow_critical_damage.desc: +20% critical multiplier per rank, up to +100% at rank 5; affects natural crits and Critical Chance crits with bows.
skill.refugio.bow_first_shot.name: First Shot
skill.refugio.bow_first_shot.desc: After 5 s without dealing combat damage, the next arrow that hits an enemy gains +15% per rank (max +75%).
skill.refugio.bow_mastery.name: Bow Mastery
skill.refugio.bow_mastery.desc: +10% bow arrow damage per rank, up to +50% at rank 5; against enemies only.
skill.refugio.steady_aim.name: Steady Aim
skill.refugio.steady_aim.desc: Reduces arrow spread by 10% per rank, up to 50%.
skill.refugio.retaliation.name: Retaliation
skill.refugio.retaliation.desc: After blocking an enemy with a shield, your 1st attack within 4 s gains +15% damage per rank (max +75%); 10 s cooldown.
skill.refugio.horde_vigor.name: Horde Vigor
skill.refugio.horde_vigor.desc: Killing an enemy activates +6% damage per rank (max +30%) for 5 s. Does not refresh while active; triggers again after expiring.
skill.refugio.area_defense.name: Area Defense
skill.refugio.area_defense.desc: When you kill an enemy (including with arrows), it explodes for 5–25 base damage to up to 1–5 visible enemies within 3–5 blocks; 60–30 s cooldown.
skill.refugio.firm_stance.name: Firm Stance
skill.refugio.firm_stance.desc: Reduces damage taken from enemies by 5% per rank (max 25%).
skill.refugio.last_reserve.name: Last Reserve
skill.refugio.last_reserve.desc: When an enemy hit would leave you at 20% health or less, reduces that hit by 20–50% by rank (preventing a fatal blow) with a screen effect; 60–20 s cooldown.
skill.refugio.anchor.name: Anchor
skill.refugio.anchor.desc: +8 percentage points of knockback resistance per rank, up to +40%.
skill.refugio.vitality_health.name: Strong Heart
skill.refugio.vitality_health.desc: +1 heart (2 health points) of maximum health per rank, up to +10 hearts at rank 10. Applies only while active. The next rank costs 500 × rank coins: 500 at rank 1, 1,000 at rank 2, up to 5,000 at rank 10.
skill.refugio.natural_regeneration.name: Natural Regeneration
skill.refugio.natural_regeneration.desc: After 10 seconds without dealing or taking damage from an enemy, regenerates 1 health point (half a heart) every 2 seconds. Thresholds use the 20 base health points: R1 below 30% to 50%; R2 below 30% to 60%; R3 below 40% to 60%; R4 below 50% to 70%; R5 below 60% to 80%. Extra health from Strong Heart does not change these percentages.
skill.refugio.vitality_on_kill.name: Life Thirst
skill.refugio.vitality_on_kill.desc: Killing a hostile enemy restores a percentage of total maximum health: 1% at rank 1, increasing by one percentage point per rank, up to 5% at rank 5.
skill.refugio.light_step.name: Light Step
skill.refugio.light_step.desc: Reduces fall damage by 10% per rank, up to 50%.
skill.refugio.burst.name: Burst
skill.refugio.burst.desc: Press the configured shortcut (%1$s) for a short horizontal impulse in the direction you face (not a teleport). Its strength factor progresses from 1 to 5, with the applied impulse reduced to shorten travel distance. Cooldown: R1 30 s, R2 20 s, R3 10 s, R4 10 s, R5 5 s; R4 and R5 have 2 charges.
skill.refugio.momentum.name: Momentum
skill.refugio.momentum.desc: +7% movement speed per rank, up to +30% at rank 5.
skill.refugio.super_jump.name: Super Jump
skill.refugio.super_jump.desc: Press the Special Jump shortcut (%1$s) once while grounded to jump higher, with no charge bar; vertical force is 0.53 to 0.65 by rank. Exclusive with Double Jump. The jump itself causes no fall damage; if you land below the starting block, damage counts only the descent below that block.
skill.refugio.double_jump.name: Double Jump
skill.refugio.double_jump.desc: Jump normally and press the Special Jump shortcut (%1$s) once in mid-air for a second jump (vertical force 0.54 to 0.70 by rank). Usable once before landing; cannot be used while mounted or in water. Exclusive with Super Jump. Fall damage counts only the descent below the first jump's starting block.
skill.refugio.mining.name: Agile Mining
skill.refugio.mining.desc: +6% mining speed per rank, up to +30%; does not reveal ores.
skill.refugio.preparation.name: Preparation
skill.refugio.preparation.desc: Each food grants +0.5 saturation per rank, up to +2.5; does not amplify potions.
skill.refugio.collector.name: Collector
skill.refugio.collector.desc: Gradually pulls visible items within a 2 to 6 block radius by rank; never creates or duplicates drops.
skill.refugio.exploration.name: Exploration
skill.refugio.exploration.desc: Reduces exhaustion by 6% per rank, up to 30% at rank 5.
skill.refugio.logistics.name: Logistics
skill.refugio.logistics.desc: Each rank gives an 8% chance to ignore 1 point of durability damage, up to 40% at rank 5.
dialogue.refugio.elias.1: I am Commander Elias Varga of the Last Line. Out there the zombie hordes show no mercy, and every creature you fell keeps this refuge standing.
dialogue.refugio.elias.2: Bring me proof of your combat against the zombies. At each milestone reached, the Last Line will grant weapons, supplies, prestige ranks, and Refuge coins.
